name: ninjacode-agent
description: Open source agentic coding agent for VS Code and multi-IDE via ACP

scripts.release:vsix: pnpm check:clean-tree && pnpm --filter ninjacode package && pnpm check:clean-tree
scripts.bench:quick: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js run --suite quick --trials 1 --provider deepseek --model deepseek-v4-flash --concurrency 4 --max-turns 20 --out runs/quick --unpublished
scripts.bench:confirm: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js run --suite quick --trials 3 --concurrency 2 --out runs/confirm
scripts.bench:harness: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js run --suite harness --provider mock --trials 1 --concurrency 4 --strict --out runs/harness
scripts.bench:holdout: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js run --tasks-dir "$NINJABENCH_HOLDOUT_DIR" --provider xai --model grok-4.6 --reasoning-effort high --trials 3 --concurrency 2 --out runs/holdout
scripts.bench:ablation:plan:quick: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js ablation plan quick
scripts.bench:ablation:plan:holdout: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js ablation plan holdout
scripts.bench:ablation:plan:public-subset: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js ablation plan public-subset
scripts.bench:harbor:plan:smoke: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor plan smoke
scripts.bench:harbor:plan:subset: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor plan subset
scripts.bench:harbor:plan:full: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor plan full
scripts.bench:harbor:plan:publish: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor plan publish
scripts.bench:harbor:smoke: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor smoke --job-name smoke -o runs/harbor
scripts.bench:harbor:subset: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor subset --job-name subset -o runs/harbor
scripts.bench:harbor:full: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor full --job-name full -o runs/harbor
scripts.bench:harbor:publish: pnpm --filter @ninjacode/bench build && node apps/bench/dist/index.js harbor publish --job-name publish -o runs/harbor
